[![MarcReisen](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/16/MarcReisen.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20211003090028)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/16/MarcReisen.png/revision/latest?cb=20211003090028)
**Marc A. Reisen** is an American industrial designer who was one of the six designers who participated in the [Hot Wheels Designers Challenge](/wiki/Designers_Challenge); he represented the [Dodge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dodge) division of [Fiat Chrysler Automobiles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiat_Chrysler_Automobiles) (now part of [Stellantis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stellantis)), for he was Creative Automotive Designer, by designing the [Dodge XP-07](/wiki/Dodge_XP-07) for said series. Reisen joined FCA in 2006 and left in 2008; he has since gone on to a wide variety of companies since then. He is currently Head of Design at Matter, a social media platform for giving and receiving feedback, where he has been since 2018.
